name: Mad Miners
seoTitle: Mad Miners: Multiplayer Mining & Treasure Hunt Game
seoDescription: Dig, mine gold and diamonds, dodge TNT and lava, and race up to 12 players to the hidden treasure. Free multiplayer mining game for Android, with offline mode.
tagline: Dig deeper. Risk more. Find the treasure.
description: A real-time multiplayer mining game. Dig through rock, dodge TNT, lava and monsters, crack open Mystery Bombs and race other miners to a treasure sealed deep underground.
